visualReview.notes: Actually inspected93 final images:14 portable,14 shared-material,30 medium-fi lighting/LOD and35 normal-placement terrain views. This round inspected the reserve axonometric/site diagram and eight actual primary photographs of the south gate/bridge, southwest tower/court, west commandant tower, north keep, palace/veranda, paired chapel windows, curtain ornament and open well pavilion. Five tower profiles and roofless court remain legible. Fresh named component plans replace original schematic spacing: checker-brick palace lies across the western side, chapel and barracks face the court on the eastern side, and the mapped timber bridge reaches the south gate through a real barrel opening. The lower window frame was moved clear of this passage. Southeast courtyard now extends to the mapped curtain connection; a ray tests that floor in addition to northern/southern court regions. Reconstructed river curtains close the missing eastern enclosure. Ornament faces outward; palace veranda and well pavilion remain open. Dedicated views show paired tall west chapel windows and lower openings. The legacy open-entrance camera sees a roof rather than the portal; the separate normal-placement portal view actually shows the full passage. Terrain contact is approved from normal-placement images, not flat geographic or diagnostic preview ground.
